tree_inventory.crs_override: Declared EPSG:4326 metadata overridden to EPSG:25833 after coordinate-range validation.

pump_register_osm.csv.grain: osm_node (one row per pump in the platform universe)
pump_register_osm.csv.universe: Nodes in Berlin that carried network or description = 'Berliner Straßenbrunnen' in at least one version (the platform selector, before and after May 2021).
pump_register_osm.csv.denominator: street_trees_* count catalogued street trees in the current frozen inventory within the radius (Euclidean, inclusive) of the pump's last mapped position.
pump_register_osm.csv.zero_semantics: Zero trees means no catalogued street tree within the radius; trees removed before the inventory snapshot are absent.
pump_register_osm.csv.claim_limit: Describes what OpenStreetMap recorded about street pumps and when it was edited. An OSM edit date is when a mapper recorded a status, not necessarily when the pump changed; edits may follow use. No watering outcome is joined or examined.

pump_status_changes_osm.csv.grain: status_transition (consecutive versions of one node with different harmonised status)
pump_status_changes_osm.csv.dates: change_time_utc is the edit instant; edit_date its Europe/Berlin date; event_date is check_date when the change is check_date-backed at day precision, else edit_date.
pump_status_changes_osm.csv.zero_semantics: A missing row means OSM recorded no change, not that the pump did not change.
pump_status_changes_osm.csv.claim_limit: Describes what OpenStreetMap recorded about street pumps and when it was edited. An OSM edit date is when a mapper recorded a status, not necessarily when the pump changed; edits may follow use. No watering outcome is joined or examined.

pump_season_panel_2019_2025.csv.grain: pump x April-September season (balanced over the universe; not-yet-mapped and deleted states are explicit statuses)
pump_season_panel_2019_2025.csv.timing: Status at start/end and in-season changes use OSM edit instants, so the start status and the change counts are mutually consistent; check_date dates are in the changes table.
pump_season_panel_2019_2025.csv.zero_semantics: n_* = 0 means no recorded change of that type in the season.
pump_season_panel_2019_2025.csv.denominator: Pumps in the universe; usable_at_start is missing when the status is unknown, not mapped or deleted.
pump_season_panel_2019_2025.csv.claim_limit: Describes what OpenStreetMap recorded about street pumps and when it was edited. An OSM edit date is when a mapper recorded a status, not necessarily when the pump changed; edits may follow use. No watering outcome is joined or examined.
